en.headline: Sham Shui Po Diwali Carnival returns to Cheung Sha Wan waterfront today
en.dek: The free community event at Townplace Pier runs from 3pm to 10pm with lantern displays, wishing water lamps, henna art and stage performances.
body: The Sham Shui Po Diwali Carnival 2026 is taking place today at Townplace Pier along the Cheung Sha Wan waterfront, organised by the Hong Kong Guangxi Associations Federation with support from the Sham Shui Po District Office and other community groups.

The free event runs from 3pm to 10pm, with an opening ceremony at 7pm. Visitors can view colourful lantern displays, release wishing water lamps, try henna art and watch stage performances celebrating the Festival of Lights.
Organisers said the carnival aims to promote cross-ethnic cultural exchange and community inclusion, combining Indian festive traditions with the harbour setting.
The site is reachable by a short walk from Nam Cheong MTR station exit B.

zh.headline: 深水埗排燈節嘉年華今日重返長沙灣海濱
zh.dek: 本舍碼頭免費社區活動下午3時至晚上10時舉行，設燈籠展示、許願水燈、海娜手繪及舞台表演。
body: 深水埗排燈節嘉年華2026今日於長沙灣海濱本舍碼頭舉行，由香港廣西社團總會主辦，並獲深水埗民政事務處及其他社區團體支持。
免費活動由下午3時至晚上10時，晚上7時舉行開幕典禮。市民可欣賞彩色燈籠、放許願水燈、體驗海娜手繪及觀看舞台表演，共慶排燈節。
主辦方表示，嘉年華旨在推廣跨族裔文化交流及社區共融，結合印度傳統節慶與海濱環境。
場地可由港鐵南昌站B出口步行前往。
